verdict.what_happens: Ball1 rolls into ball2, which rolls into ball3. Ball3 rolls into the cup, touches its back, rebounds slightly, and settles inside. All three balls are at rest at the end.

usage.text:
The three balls begin in a row on the floor. Ball1 rolls into ball2 at 0.16 s, sending ball2 forward. Ball2 strikes ball3 at 0.35 s, sending ball3 into the side-facing cup. Ball3 reaches the cup’s back, rebounds slightly, and settles inside at about 1.05 s. All three balls remain at rest through 6 s.
